description.text: The second expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released on 6 March 2020 and led by Toxtricity VMAX, whose attack does 240 damage to a Poisoned Pokémon. Dragapult VMAX, Malamar VMAX and Copperajah VMAX join it, with Eldegoss V, whose Ability takes a Supporter back from the discard pile, and Boss's Orders, a Supporter that brings one of the opponent's Benched Pokémon into the Active Spot. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 96, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some in new illustrations, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Galarian Perrserker, Scoop Up Net and Tool Scrapper. In English most of its cards came out in Rebel Clash in May 2020.
